title: Implement GrobidStructureEnricher in alcanzai-understanding
description:
Salvage reference (READ ONLY — reimplement to contract, never copy): prototype/paper_library/grobid_processor.py (939 lines).

Implement GrobidStructureEnricher against the Enricher protocol in alcanzai_understanding/enricher.py.

- enricher_id: 'grobid-structure'
- priority: 10 (runs before citation enricher)
- applies_to: ContentType.ACADEMIC_PDF only
- enrich(document): reads artifact_path from document.provenance.source_metadata['artifact_path']; POSTs PDF to ALCANZAI_GROBID_URL (default http://localhost:8070) /api/processFulltextDocument; parses TEI XML response into list[Block] (heading, paragraph, running_header, footnote with sequence, page, bbox where available); returns EnrichmentResult(data={'grobid_sections': [...blocks...], 'grobid_abstract': str | None, 'tei_metadata': dict}).

Design question resolved here: enricher accesses raw PDF via artifact_path in source_metadata (written by ArxivSource.fetch to job dir) — not via Enricher protocol extension. This keeps enrich(RawDocument) signature unchanged.

GROBID failure: set EnrichmentResult.error; do NOT raise. Coordinator decides whether to fail the job.

Acceptance:
- Unit test: mock GROBID HTTP response with saved TEI XML from 1706.03762; assert correct Block list returned.
- Integration test (@pytest.mark.integration): real GROBID call on 1706.03762 returns >= 10 heading blocks.
